subject.title: feat(telegram): handle unknown groups with warn or leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in Telegram unknown-group warn/leave config, and what exact blocked-group cases may trigger the destructive `leaveChat` side effect?
rationale: The PR adds new user-facing config and a Telegram leave operation at an authorization boundary, so automation cannot choose whether this behavior belongs in the Telegram plugin, a broader group-pairing design, or the current deny-only posture.

options.title: Revise This Telegram PR
options.body: Keep the feature opt-in, but require precise unknown-chat classification, native-command parity, forum-topic correctness, docs/schema alignment, and real Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Defer To Group Pairing
options.body: Pause this channel-specific PR and fold the behavior into the broader group admission and owner-notification design tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/11489.

options.title: Keep Deny-Only Groups
options.body: Reject warn/leave config for now and keep current Telegram behavior limited to allowlist/drop plus static command denial.

recommendation.title: Revise This Telegram PR
recommendation.body: Keep the feature opt-in, but require precise unknown-chat classification, native-command parity, forum-topic correctness, docs/schema alignment, and real Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the Telegram authorization/config paths and is already the routing candidate for the paired issue’s product/security decision.
